documents.title: Endocrine therapy of advanced carcinoma of the prostate
documents.abstract:
Abstract

Increasing evidence suggests that growth of the prostatic tissue is regulated by a network of hormones and growth factors, in which androgens play the prominent role. Hormonal manipulation remains the core of treatment for locally advanced and metastatic prostate cancer. Achievement of a complete androgen blockade, by surgical or medical means or a combination of both, offers superior results in palliative management of advanced disease. Management of hormonal refractory cancer, however, remains a challenge to clinicians.
documents.author: Daneshgari, Firouz;Crawford, E. David;

documents.title: IT/OT Convergence 기반의 Advanced Distribution Management System의 설계
documents.abstract: Power automation system to operate power distribution systems can be distinguished by distribution SCADA with remote monitoring and control; and distribution automation system with basic functions such as service restoration to the distribution SCADA; and distribution management system which is operated by various applications in order to enhance distribution system operation performance based on the distribution automation system. In the technological change, a technical boundary of information technology (IT) and operation technology (OT) is being blurred by that new concepts such as interoperability. In addtion, IT/OT convergence has been proposed by the improvement of ICT and power system technology. At the viewpoint, advanced distribution management system (ADMS) to have the new concepts and to increase distribution system operation efficiency through global information and functions from the other systems has been proposed.In order to implement the ADMS, IT and OT have to be employed together on the ADMS; and the concept-based IT/OT convergence concept has been presented. Therefore, this paper introduces ADMS and IT/OT convergence and proposes a design of IT/OT convergence based ADMS system design with configurations and functions.
documents.author: 임일형;이승주;박종호;신용학;

documents.title: Advanced Distribution Management System
documents.abstract: This paper proposes an advanced distribution management system (DMS) that a) monitors each component and performs protection functions using a dynamic state estimation, b) the estimated states are transmitted to the DMS where the real time model of the entire feeder is synthesized, c) uses the real time model to perform upper level optimization (operations planning) and lower level optimization (real time control) via a hierarchical optimization procedure; and d) applies proper controls to operate the system at optimal points. The proposed approach for protection, operations planning, and real time control of the system provides the infrastructure for additional important applications. As an example, the paper presents a novel application for monitoring available reserves from all resources in the system. We propose the concept of Reserve-O-Meter that monitors in real time the available reserves from all resources (utility and customer owned).
documents.author: Meliopoulos, A. P. Sakis;Polymeneas, Evangelos;Zhenyu Tan;Renke Huang;Dongbo Zhao;

documents.title: 차세대 배전지능화시스템 개발을 위한 지리정보시스템 적용
documents.abstract: 최근 신재생 분산전원의 투입 확대로 배전계통 내 변동성이 커짐에 따라서 안정적인 배전계통 운영에 대한 우려가 커지고 있는 상황이다. 미래 배전계통의 효율적인 관리를 위해서 새로운 시각화 기술을 이용한 배전계통 운영시스템의 개선이 필요하다. 본 논문에서는 배전분야의 GIS 도입 현황과 관련 기술 동향을 기술하고, 배전계통 운영을 위해 GIS시스템의 필요성과 GIS기술 도입 시 해결해야할 문제점을 분석한다.
documents.author: 김동욱;조성호;서호진;박영배;

documents.title: Advanced Distribution Management System: Improving Distribution Efficiency Through an Integrated Approach
documents.abstract: Due to technology advancements and the adoption of similar hardware and software platforms and common communication standards, there are opportunities for increased interfacing and data exchange between information and operational systems. The power distribution sector is no exception. The global power sector, especially distribution and retail, is witnessing a rapid influx of operations technology and IT systems that ensure a reliable power supply to consumers, resolve customer complaints in the least time possible, meet consumer expectations, and facilitate the integration of disruptive technologies like renewable energy integration, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and battery energy storage solutions (BESSs). These technologies are also required to enable the real-time monitoring of electricity network parameters to improve operational efficiency and reduce network losses.
documents.author: Devanand, P.;Rastogi, Rajkumar;Ahmad, Md Shadab;Batra, Tarun;Ohja, Anil;Kumar M, Vinod;Das, G. Ganesh;Ansari, Mehnaz;

documents.title: Advanced Distribution Management System: Implementation, Assessment, and Challenges
documents.abstract: In recent years, massive numbers of distributed energy resources are being installed in distribution feeders at both the utility and customer levels. These integrations are creating bi-directional power flow complexities in all the existing functionalities of distribution management system (DMS) and outage management system (OMS). Therefore, a significant interest is growing among utilities to combine all the DMS and OMS functionalities with distributed energy resources management system. This combined structure is known as advanced distribution management system (ADMS). In this paper, major ADMS functionalities, such as, conservation voltage reduction, fault location, isolation, and service restoration, and demand response are described with existing and aspiring implementation and assessment. Future challenges are also described from the utility perspective.
documents.author: Hossan, Md Shakawat;Chowdhury, Badrul;Schoene, Jens;Bahramirad, Shay;

documents.title: Advanced Water Distribution System Modeling and Management
documents.author: 박용균

documents.title: Advanced Applications in an Advanced Distribution Management System: Essentials for Implementation and Integration
documents.abstract: For more than a decade, the distribution utility industry has recognized and increasingly accepted the concept of an advanced distribution management system (ADMS). In a nutshell, an ADMS combines the functional domains of distribution supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system, the outage management system, switching management, and distribution network analysis and optimization into a single seamless system. The distribution network analysis and optimization functions are referred to as advanced applications. However, surprisingly few distribution utilities have successfully implemented an ADMS with advanced applications. Even fewer have system operators making full use of such applications. Numerous small-scale pilot projects have been executed and completed where the value of such advanced applications as fault location isolation and service restoration (FLISR) and integrated volt/volt-ampere reactive optimization (IVVO) have been positively confirmed. Successful systemwide operational deployments of advanced applications, however, are much less common. There are multiple reasons for this, including insufficient numerical robustness of advanced applications to provide solutions under a wide variety of system conditions. Other reasons include model-magnitude, complexity, and data-quality issues.
documents.author: Boardman, Ethan

documents.title: A Novel Cloud-Based Advanced Distribution Management System Solution
documents.abstract: This paper proposes a novel advanced distribution management system (ADMS) solution based on a common operation technology platform implemented on a cloud infrastructure. It introduces a virtualization methodology that is used to transition and deploy a traditional, monolithic ADMS in a cloud environment. First, typical ADMS functional blocks (FBs) are identified and their performance is evaluated with respect to four major metrics: processor, memory, network, and storage utilization. Next, a cloud infrastructure-based ADMS solution is presented, based on a collection of FBs mapped to a set of virtual machines. Finally, the proposed architecture is validated via deployment on a physical hardware platform with two representatively sized distribution networks and emulated workloads. Obtained results show that an ADMS, as a mission-critical system, can be deployed on a cloud infrastructure, providing many benefits of virtualized solutions, without negative impact on system performance.
documents.author: Popovic, Nemanja D.;Popovic, Dragan S.;

documents.title: 스마트팩토리 IT 및 OT 영역 내 보안위협 관련 데이터 통합 처리 및 관리 아키텍처
documents.abstract: 스마트팩토리는 기존 제조산업과 ICT(Information & Communication Technology)가 융합된 지능형 공장이다. 이는 직접적인 제조공정 과정이 수행되는 OT(Operational Technology) 영역(0~3계층)과 전사업무 관리를 수행하는 IT(Information Technology) 영역(4~5계층)으로 구분되며, 각 영역과 계층이 연결되어 제조·물류·유통 과정의 자동화 및 지능화를 제공한다. 그러나 각 영역과 계층이 연결됨에 따라 보안위협 벡터가 증가하고 있으며, 다영역·다계층 환경인 스마트팩토리에 적합한 대응체계 연구를 위해 영역별 보안위협 관련 데이터를 통합하여 처리 및 관리하는 아키텍처 연구가 필요한 실정이다. 이에 따라 본 논문에서는 스마트팩토리 환경 내 IT 및 OT 영역 장치를 식별하고 보안위협 관련 데이터 통합 처리 및 관리를 위한 아키텍처를 제안한다.
documents.author: 정인수;김득훈;곽진;

documents.title: IMPLEMENTING A CYBERSECURITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM IN AN OPERATIONAL TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT
documents.abstract: This study provides a comprehensive threat analysis framework that combines standard IT security controls with a specific Operational Technology (OT) environment. The integration of this framework in a real-world case study and demonstration of its effectiveness in identifying potential cybersecurity threats in an OT environment are discussed in this paper. This study primarily aims to incorporate practical guidance for OT industry professionals and cybersecurity policies. Due to the proposed combination of both IT and OT security measures, the proposed framework offers an effective cybersecurity approach. Additionally, the study provides a comprehensive review of the literature. The results and evaluation of the framework led us to recommend strategies and steps that are implemented to introduce real-world directions for OT industry experts, cybersecurity policy and strategy implementers, and all people involved in cybersecurity to empower and improve the flexibility of critical OT environments against any advanced and complex cybersecurity threats.
documents.author: Al-Majali, Osama Habes Sharari

documents.title: IT-OT Integration Challenges in Utilities
documents.abstract: Emerging industrial IoT presupposes integration of operational technology (OT) networks with information technology (IT) networks which hitherto were isolated. IT networks focus primarily on PAIN (Privacy/Confidentiality, Authentication, Integrity and Non-repudiation) OT networks focus primarily on AIC (Availability, Integrity and Confidentiality). The conflicting requirements of availability and confidentiality is a challenge that needs to be overcome in a balanced way to reap the benefits of IT-OT integration. This balancing act requires understanding of the OT domain. This paper considers electrical utility as the use case and brings out the considerations in achieving an acceptable IT-OT framework.
documents.author: Garimella, Phani Kumar

documents.title: 제어 네트워크 경계에 대한 OT-IT 책임 역할 연구
documents.abstract: In recent years, due to the demand for operating efficiency and cost reduction of industrial facilities, remote access via the Internet is expanding. the control network accelerates from network separation to network connection due to the development of IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things) technology. Transition of control network is a new opportunity, but concerns about cybersecurity are also growing. Therefore, manufacturers must reflect security compliance and standards in consideration of the Internet connection environment, and enterprises must newly recognize the connection area of the control network as a security management target. In this study, the core target of the control system security threat is defined as the network boundary, and issues regarding the security architecture configuration for the boundary and the role & responsibility of the working organization are covered. Enterprises do not integrate the design organization with the operation organization after go-live, and are not consistently reflecting security considerations from design to operation. At this point, the expansion of the control network is a big transition that calls for the establishment of a responsible organization and reinforcement of the role of the network boundary area where there is a concern about lack of management. Thus, through the organization of the facility network and the analysis of the roles between each organization, an static perspective and difference in perception were derived. In addition, standards and guidelines required for reinforcing network boundary security were studied to address essential operational standards that required the Internet connection of the control network. This study will help establish a network boundary management system that should be considered at the enterprise level in the future.
documents.author: 우영한;권헌영;

documents.title: Construction of the Operational Risk Management System of Bank by Information Technology
documents.abstract: The extensive application of information technology in all walks of life, extend the space of electronic commerce, commercial banks are also under various pressure. In recent years, because of the wrong operation brings huge economic losses, the risk to commercial banks in the management process is more and more complex. In the 21st century, the commercial banks have made great adjustment in the management process, during the exchanged system period, it is very easy to cause the risk. So China commercial banks began to pay attention to risk management in the management process. In the process of bank risk management , the application of information technology has an important role.
documents.author: Li, Zhi Gang

documents.title: Information Technology Implementation and Operational Efficiency
documents.abstract: In this paper, we analyze the relationship between implementation of information technology and inventory turnover as a measure of operational efficiency. We build a regression model including a dummy variable that indicates whether a firm has been nominated for being good at implementing information technology. By using publicly available data, we have conducted an extensive empirical analysis and found that firms' using information technology is not likely to affect inventory turnover significantly. This result implies that we have to take careful consideration in adapting information technology.
documents.author: Kwak, Jin Kyung

documents.title: 4IR integration of information technology best practice framework in operational technology
documents.abstract: Purpose: Since inception in the 1970s, Operational Technology (OT) systems were designed to operate in isolation from Information Technology (IT) systems mainly due to differences in objectives relating to Confidentiality, Integrity, Security and Availability (CISA). Additional diverse components include computing speed, and failure severity in terms of safety, environmental, and financial impact. With the onset of Industry 4.0 and the need for integration the worlds of IT and OT must operate in unison. The focal point of this research is to evaluate if an Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) best practice framework can be integrated into the operational technology domain.Design/methodology/approach: A qualitative desk research methodology initiates data gathering on the two key domains. A comparative analysis is subsequently adopted for results analysis. Thereafter, an application case of ITSM inclusive of OT is proposed and reviewed.Findings: After comparative analysis and application case, the research concludes that an IT best practice framework i.e. the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) can be integrated and adapted into the operational technology domain to facilitate management of OT in a service management style.Practical implications: The key benefit of this work is the inclusion of OT in global IT best practices in this Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) era.Originality/value: This paper contributes to ongoing research in IT-OT integration by providing a unique perspective on OT management in the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR). Other researchers can utilize the research outcomes to apply ITSM in the OT domain where 4IR technologies have been implemented.
documents.author: Shilenge, Musa;Telukdarie, Arnesh;

documents.title: Operational Risk Management and Information Technology
documents.author: Holmquist, E.

documents.title: Helping IT and OT Defenders Collaborate
documents.abstract: Cyber-physical systems, especially in critical infrastructures, have become primary hacking targets in international conflicts and diplomacy. However, cyber-physical systems present unique challenges to defenders, starting with an inability to communicate. This paper outlines the results of our interviews with information technology (IT) defenders and operational technology (OT) operators and seeks to address lessons learned from them in the structure of our notional solutions. We present two problems in this paper: (1) the difficulty of coordinating detection and response between defenders who work on the cyber/IT and physical/OT sides of cyber-physical infrastructures, and (2) the difficulty of estimating the safety state of a cyber-physical system while an intrusion is underway but before damage can be effected by the attacker. To meet these challenges, we propose two solutions: (1) a visualization that will enable communication between IT defenders and OT operators, and (2) a machine-learning approach that will estimate the distance from normal the physical system is operating and send information to the visualization.
documents.author: Fink, Glenn A.;Shulga, Yana;

documents.title: 가상배전계통과 ADMS 간 DNP 통신 연계 시 이벤트 발생 시간 정확성 확보에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: 최근 국내 배전계통에 분산전원의 접속 증가와 배전망의 복잡도가 높아지고 있다. 안정적이며, 효율적인 분산전원의 계통접속, 복잡한 배전 전력망의 안정적 운영, 전기품질 확보를 위해 기존 전력 수급 계획과 운영 업무 전반에 새로운 기술이 요구되고 있다. 또한 개인사업소 및 에너지 프로슈머의 등장에 따라 능동적인 차세대 배전운영시스템의 도입이 요구되고 있다.&#xD; 차세대 배전 운영시스템(Advanced Distribution Management System, ADMS) 및 운영 어플리케이션을 실제 배전계통에서 활용하기 위해서는 체계적인 검증과 평가가 필요하다. 따라서 차세대 운영시스템의 다양한 기능을 수행하고 평가할 수 있는 시험환경이 구축 되어야한다. 하지만 실제 배전계통을 대상으로 모의실험 수행 시 많은 문제가 발생하기 때문에 실제 배전계통과 동일한 환경을 갖는 가상의 물리환경이 필요하다. 이러한 환경은 가상 배전계통이라 불리며, 운영시스템과 연계 시 실제 환경과 유사하게 배전계통에서 사용되는 DNP 3.0(Distribution Network Protocol 3.0)을 활용한다. 하지만 DNP 표준(IEEE 1815)으로 이벤트를 처리할 경우 가상 배전계통과 ADMS 간 이벤트 발생 시간정보가 정확하지 않다.&#xD; 본 논문에서는 가상 배전계통이라는 특수한 환경에서 발생하는 이벤트 시간 정보가 DNP를 통해 ADMS에 연계되는 과정에서 발생하는 시간 정보의 정확성 및 적시성에 대한 문제점을 해결할 수 있는 방안을 제시한다. ADMS의 인입접인 FEP 내부의 DNP Master와 가상배전계통을 구축하여, 기존 방안과 제안한 방안을 적용해 성능을 검증하였다.
documents.author: 백지운

documents.title: ADMS-Automatic Diabetic Management System
documents.abstract: Diabetes could be a common chronic disease in mostly all countries worldwide. Monitoring of glucose level of blood is vital to avoid complications of diabetic and damage to organs. The most commonly used method to live glucose level in blood is an invasive method which is painful, expensive and danger in spreading infectious diseases. Over an extended term, the invasive method results in damage of finger tissues. The proposed system works on a diabetes patient, and gives information about patient condition to patient carer or observer. Patient’s fingertip is placed between the glucose measuring sensors that measure glucose value through the help of microcontroller. If the glucose level is increased insulin injector will automatically inject the insulin in the body and if it is decreased glucose is injected. Patient’s mobile application use to see glucose measurement at each time and also the injected glucose and insulin amount. In critical condition, sms containing vital information and location are sent to doctor or relative’s phone.

documents.title: Advanced Information Security Management Evaluation System
documents.abstract: Information security management systems (ISMSs) are used to manage information about their customers and themselves by governments or business organizations following advances in e-commerce, open networks, mobile networks, and Internet banking. This paper explains the existing ISMSs and presents a comparative analysis. The discussion deals with different types of ISMSs. We addressed issues within the existing ISMSs via analysis. Based on these analyses, then we proposes the development of an information security management evaluation system (ISMES). The method can be applied by a self-evaluation of the organization and an evaluation of the organization by the evaluation committee. The contribution of this study enables an organization to refer to and improve its information security levels. The case study can also provide a business organization with an easy method to build ISMS and the reduce cost of information security evaluation.
documents.author: Jo, Hea-Suk;Kim, Seung-Joo;Won, Dong-Ho;

documents.title: Implementation of Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS)
documents.abstract: The Distribution Companies are required to restrict drawl of power from the grid to comply with the specified frequency requirements so as to overcome any threat to system security in an interconnected system on account of overdrawal from the grid. The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) of India mandates manual as well as automatic demand disconnection from the distribution network under overdrawal conditions and on crossing the defined frequency limits. As the manual control at times become ineffective to decrease drawal by a certain quantum within the time limit and hence the automatic demand disconnection scheme assumes significant importance for Distribution Companies operating in developing countries like India to restrict drawl in its control area. The Automatic Under frequency Load Shed (AUFLS) and load relief by rate of change of frequency relay are the defence mechanism whereas Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS) acts as a tool for ensuring security and reliability of the interconnected system. This paper aims to present details of a unique state-of-the-art Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS) implemented for the State Distribution System by the Transmission Utility of the State of Madhya Pradesh in India, which not only disconnects the interruptible loads but also restores the same automatically on clearing the overdrawal conditions. Under this system real time information is gathered through the transmission Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System and based on logics developed for the scheme, automatic load disconnection & restoration is achieved through the control output of Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) installed for SCADA System of State Transmission network.
documents.author: Sethi, Ravi;Choubey, A. K.;Lingfei, Yan;Pei, Wang;

results.question: Could you outline the principal concerns IT companies face in defense-related IT convergence and the proposed solutions for cost estimation and governance?

documents.title: 국방 IT 거버넌스 개선에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: 현대의 정보화 사회에서는 정보기술이 기업과 공공기관에 도입되면서 정보기술 전반을 관리해야 한다는 필요성이 대두되었고, 비즈니스 목표와 IT의 연계 필요성이 증대되고 함께 IT투자의 중복을 방지하고 ROI를 추구하는 조직들이 늘어났다. 이에 여러 선진 기업들이 IT 거버넌스라는 개념을 제창하였다. IT 거버넌스는 기업의 비즈니스와 IT에 영향을 미치는 구조적 결정인자들의 구조 및 동적양상을 나타내며, 비즈니스와 IT 관련 사내외 위원회 및 부서, 그리고 그들의 활동범위 및 연관관계를 나타내는 프레임워크, 조직도 및 프로세스 구성으로 표현이 된다. 이러한 외부적인 요인과 맞물려 현재 우리 군의 국방 비전과 목표를 달성하기 위한 국방 IT 거버넌스의 재확립은 필수적인 사항이 되었다. 본 논문에서는 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크를 구축하기 위한 핵심 추진전략에 대해서 기술하였다. 이러한 주장에 뒷받침하기 위해서 IT 거버넌스의 전반적인 내용을 기술하고 국내 외와 해외의 군 사례를 분석하여 보고 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크 구축을 위한 핵심 추진전략을 연구하였다.
documents.author: 양호경;박현규;차현종;조용건;

documents.title: 금융산업 IT Governance와 IT 부서 평가 : S은행 사례를 중심으로
documents.abstract: This paper suggests the process of IT governance and performance measurement system development for IT division of financial company using IT-BSC(Balanced Scorecard). Main features and factors affecting IT governance and performance of IT division of financial company were derived based on literatures. The normative IT governance and performance measurement model for IT division of financial company was suggested. This model was based on IT-BSC which was suggested by Prof. Grembergen for measuring IT division of company. In order to apply the developed evaluation model with some adjustments, the real evaluation case study for a bank was performed as the last step of this thesis. This real study was co-worked with the members of a bank. By their assistance, this real study could find another important evaluating factors. The members decided weights of performance indicators through the designed questionnaires for the model and the weight for each measure was calculated by using geometric mean of their results. The results of this case study were very satisfactory that the suggested IT governance and IT performance measurement system is useful and applicable to the real case
documents.author: 진용선

documents.title: 컨버전스, 가치사슬 지배구조, 기업성과 간의 영향도 분석 : IT, 정보통신, 미디어 및 엔터테인먼트 산업을 중심으로
documents.abstract: The Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) sectors are undergoing a fundamental transformation. Determinant factors in this transformation process are deregulations and technological advancements, resulting in an important move toward business and industry convergence. Regarding the value chain perspective, industry convergence plays the most central role in the transformation of the established and new telecommunications and media industries. In spite of the large number of and diverse literature on convergence, relatively few have specifically dealt with the business and industry perspectives with the empirical approach. The objective of this dissertation is to examine the impact of convergence on the cross-industry value chain governance and business performance using analytical model with empirical data. To identify the various effects being driven by industry convergence, this study is organized by three perspectives of relationships between convergence and its consequences; those are the relations between convergence and cross-industry structure, firm performance, and value chain governance. In the first study, we analyzed the convergence patterns and cross-industry network structures established on the relations between telecom, Internet, broadcasting, entertainment and cable industries. To evaluate the degree of convergence, a value chain governance model was developed and applied to about 700 companies which are doing business in Korean ICT sector. A results based on data from 1999-2005 indicate that, the degree of cross-industry convergence has been continuously increased in all seven years. The results also showed that telecom sector played the leading role in driving ICT convergence. In addition, we found Internet, terrestrial broadcasting, and entertainment industries noticeably transforming their cross-sectoral relations in accordance with the changes of their strategic necessity over this time period. In the second research, we performed regression analysis to examine the relationships between firm’s degree of convergence and the business performance of our companies during 2002-2005. In the research model, we used Tobin’s q, a financial market-based measure, as a proxy variable of firm performance and firm’s degree of convergence as an independent variable. The analytical results indicate that in the recent years, 2004 and 2005, the inclusion of the convergence index in the model increased the variance explained in Tobin’s q significantly. These results are consistent with the notion that higher degree of convergence is associated with higher market value. However, the positive effects of convergence on firm performance are only recent phenomena, and further research is needed to certify the effect of convergence strategy on performance. Finally, in light of value chain governance of converged ICT sector, the relations between value chain governance and business performance are examined. The objective is to identify which combination between value chain stages is lead to better business performance. In the research, we classify our sample companies to converged ICT value chain stages (content stage, delivery channel stage, and device/interface stage) and identify its impact on business performance through regression model. The results indicate that relations within contents stage are most significant and the relations between delivery channel and content are also have significant impact on firm performance. In this dissertation, we study the relations between industry convergence and business performance with value chain governance concept. Through a thorough analysis of these three researches, this study hopes to provide policy implications and strategic insights to regulators and managers in ICT sector.

documents.abstract: In more and more companies considering to apply 'IT Governance' in their business management activity for avoiding risk, improving competitive power in order to accomplish their business target. IT Governance connects between IT Strategy and process activities to business strategy and that is core function for supporting business management. However, until by now, the fundamental notions of IT Governance will define different by research institution, academic world, and companies. In addition, the detail realization method for IT Governance is more confusion circumstances because of vendor or executor offering different approach. Goal of IT Governance is not new concept because it connecting between business strategy and IT strategy through in order to achieve Value Creation, Risk Management, IT Resource Management and IT BSC. Rather the concepts of IT Governance define that systematic thesis built by various IT management activities and control activities by existing organization experience. Therefore, this article will present followings. First, information about IT Management System(ITMS) for efficient way of realization and second, offer to method approach for realization in which base on IT Governance experience by IT Organization based on IT Management and Control Activity(IT Planning, IT Project Management, IT Operation Management, IT Asset Management, IT Standard and IT Performance Management)

documents.title: Cybernetic governance: implications of technology convergence on governance convergence
documents.abstract:
Abstract

Governance theory in political science and international relations has to adapt to the onset of an increasingly digital society. However, until now, technological advancements and the increasing convergence of technologies outpace regulatory efforts and frustrate any efforts to apply ethical and legal frameworks to these domains. This is due to the convergence of multiple, sometimes incompatible governance frameworks that accompany the integration of technologies on different platforms. This theoretical claim will be illustrated by examples such as the integration of technologies on the “human platform” as it is referred to in the case of enhanced soldiers. Hence, successful governance might require new approaches borrowed from a distant relative, namely cybernetics. Insights gained from cybernetics for governance theories might be able to give guidance for a more efficient and adaptive governance approach that is able to deal with increasing complexity caused by technology and governance convergence. While cybernetics itself might be considered a governance approach, it has had surprisingly little reception in the wider field of governance within the area of social and political sciences. This article will develop cybernetic governance as a set of expandable governance principles that are applicable to an increasingly complex digital and smart society. It thereby tries to further galvanise what could be termed cybernetic governance theory as a subject of worthwhile insights from the combination of otherwise largely the disjoined fields of cybernetics and governance.

documents.title: 국방 IT 거버넌스 및 원칙 수립에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: 많은 조직들이 급변하는 환경에 능동적으로 대처하기 위하여 IT를 활용하여 전략을 수립하고 있다. 사업적 목표와 IT 구축의 목표를 일치 시키고 IT 자산을 효율적으로 관리하며, 투자 투명성을 확보하기 위하여 IT 거버넌스를 도입한다. 특히 국제 정세가 빠르게 변화함에 따라 국방 정보의 거버넌스 역시 중요시 되었다. 하지만 국방 IT 거버넌스를 체계적으로 규명한 연구는 미흡하다. 본 연구에서는 선행 연구들로부터 도출한 시사점들과 대한민국 국방 상황의 고유 성격에 근거하여 국방 IT 거버넌스를 정의하였다. 또한 국방정보 거버넌스의 프레임워크를 제안하였고, 의사결정 체계를 고안하였으며, 이를 토대로 원칙을 수립하였다. 본 연구의 결과는 장기적 관점에서 국방 정보에 유용한 지침이 될 것으로 기대된다.

documents.abstract: 전자금융서비스가 일반 국민들의 생활과 기업 활동 속에 보편화되고 있는 가운데 스마트폰의 보급, 신기술의 등장, 글로벌 네트워크화, 타 산업과 금융산업의 융합화 등으로 인하여 해외 금융선진국들은 물론 국내에서도 새로운 전자금융 환경이 조성되고 있다. 또한 다양한 산업간 융합화로 인하여 금융시스템의 안정성과 효율성에 대한 우려가 증가하고 있다. 이로 인해 보다 다양한 이해관계자들 간의 이해조정과 협력을 이끌어 낼 수 있는 금융정보화 추진체계의 역할과 책임에 대한 기대가 증가하고 있다. 이와 같은 환경변화에 따라 현행 금융정보화 추진체계에 대한 재검토가 필요한 상황이다. 본 연구는 현행 금융정보화 거버넌스가 현재의 환경 하에서 내포하고 있는 취약점 및 개선 방안을 도출하는 것을 목표로 현 금융정보화 추진체계인 “금융정보화추진협의회”와 그동안 수행되었거나 수행중인 금융정보화 사업 사례 7가지를 IT 거버넌스 측면에서 분석하였다. 그 결과, 금융정보화 거버넌스의 개선 방안으로 주요 정책 관계자의 참여와 역학 재정립, 다양해지는 이해관계자들의 참여 또는 이해 반영, 유연한 거버넌스 체계 구축, 정보화의 성과 평가, 금융 아키텍처와 인프라스트럭처 관련 문제들에 대한 리더십, 전자금융의 공공성 지원 및 구현을 도출하였다.

documents.title: 서비스 요청 관리 프로세스 개선을 통한 IT 운영비용 최적화 방안
documents.abstract: Recently, researches on IT Service Management (ITSM) for improving information system operation service and information system outsourcing cost estimation model are proliferating. This study suggests a new cost model of IT operation service and optimizing method based upon the characteristics of operation service as a long-term and continuous business service for both user's and service provider's point of view. This study explains the cost optimization model of IT operation service by improving service request management process, such as adequate reception and control, proper valuation, process management using project management methodology, effective organization and time management of service personnel. Especially in this study, service ability improvement effect and fixed operation cost reduction effect are defined to prove the proposed new cost model.

documents.title: Corporate Governance Convergence and Moral Relativism
documents.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Manuscript Type:

Conceptual

Research Question/Issue:

This paper frames the debate on corporate governance convergence in terms of the morality underlying corporate governance models. The claims and arguments of moral relativism are presented to provide theoretical structure to the moral aspects of corporate governance convergence, and ultimately the normative question of whether convergence should occur.

Research Findings/Results:

The morality underlying different models of corporate governance has largely been ignored in the corporate governance convergence literature. A range of moral philosophies and principles that underlie the dominant corporate governance models are identified. This leads to a consideration of the claims and arguments of moral relativism relating to corporate governance. A research agenda around the claims of descriptive and meta-ethical moral relativism, and which ultimately informs the associated normative argument, is then suggested.

Theoretical Implications:

The application of moral relativism to the debate on corporate governance convergence presents a theoretical structure to the analysis and consideration of its moral aspects. This structure lends itself to further research, both empirical and conceptual.

Practical Implications:

The claims and arguments of moral relativism provide a means of analyzing calls that are made for a culturally or nationally “appropriate” model of corporate governance. This can assist in providing direction for corporate governance reforms and is of particular relevance for developing countries that have inherited Western corporate governance models through colonialism.

documents.title: 국내 금융기관의 IT 거버넌스 체계에 관한 연구 : IT 거버넌스 원칙을 중심으로
documents.abstract: In recent years, research has begun to place greater emphasis on the strategic use of IT in seeking to build firm's capability, thus innovating firm's business value. Many leading firms have been put efforts to formulate and implement IT governance (ITG) structures, processes, and mechanisms for firm's IT activities. However, recent literatures reviews found that ITG framework have been discussed independently rather than in an integrated and on convergent manner failing to provide comprehensive conceptual framework. The objective of this paper is therefore, to develop a conceptual framework that enable to conduct a comparative ITG case studies. The proposed framework, developed by one of author, has extensively applied in real case study to validate its usefulness and also aims to contribute practitioners to understand how well IT principles are formed within the organization as well as corelate with ITG objectives and ITG execution.

documents.title: The Convergence of COSYSMO Parametric Cost Estimation with Model‐Based Systems Engineering
documents.abstract:
Abstract

The promise of Model‐Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and its advertised benefits hinge on the ability of our profession to integrate engineering disciplines and project management across the system life cycle. In particular, connecting system architecture and design decisions to the economics of the system's development is a critically important topic, but has often been overlooked by the system engineering community. Achieving such integration requires two key elements: (1) the standardization of multidisciplinary terms and functions, and (2) the establishment of rules governing relationships between cross‐functional models and modeling environments. This paper contributes to these areas by (1) establishing common terminology describing systems engineering and cost estimating, and (2) proposing specific cost drivers and counting rules within an MBSE environment that can be applied to estimating systems engineering effort using the COSYSMO cost model. COSYSMO is a systems engineering cost model, originally developed in 2005, and was grounded on document‐based systems engineering methods. This paper facilitates the convergence of COSYSMO and MBSE by updating the COSYSMO counting rules to specifically address size driver selection and assessment in a SysML model. It illustrates how advanced modeling tool features streamline and automate cost estimation activities, while queries and crosscutting views offered by modern MBSE tools enhance the completeness, quality, and consistency of parametric cost estimation process. Additionally, it provides guidelines for identifying system model content and level of detail for cost estimating, and proposes an approach to link attributes and properties in a system model to the variables in the COSYSMO cost estimating relationship.
documents.author: Papke, Barry;Wang, Gan;Densford, Sean;Valerdi, Ricardo;

documents.title: Cost-Guided Cardinality Estimation: Focus Where it Matters
documents.abstract: The increasing prevalence of machine learning techniques has resulted in many works attempting to replace cardinality estimation, a core component of relational query optimizers, with learned models. The majority of those works have trained models to minimize the prediction error between the model’s output for a particular query and the true cardinality of that query. However, when cardinality estimators are used for query optimization, not all cardinality estimates are equally important. We present cost-guided cardinality estimation, a technique to train learned cardinality estimators that penalizes models for errors that lead to sub-optimal query plans, and rewards models for estimates that lead to high-quality query plans, regardless of the accuracy of those estimates. In a preliminary experimental study, we show that our technique can reduce average query runtime by 1.7-2×. Surprisingly, models trained with our approach achieve this increase in query performance while having higher prediction error than models trained without our approach, suggesting that prediction error for cardinalities is not necessarily the correct metric to optimize.

documents.title: Comparison of estimation methods of cost and duration in IT projects
documents.abstract: Producing accurate and reliable project cost estimations at an early stage of a project's life cycle remains a substantial challenge in the information technology field. This research benchmarks the performance of various approaches to estimating IT project effort and duration. Empirical data were gathered from various ''real-world'' organizations including several prominent Israeli high-tech companies as well as from the International Software Benchmarking Standards Group (ISBSG) IT project database. The study contrasts two types of models that have been employed to estimate project duration and effort separately: linear regression estimation models and models deriving from a more novel approach based on artificial neural networks (ANNs).

documents.title: On convergence of the iterative conditional estimation
documents.abstract: The iterative conditional estimation (ICE) is an iterative estimation method of the parameters in the case of incomplete data. Its use asks for relatively weak hypotheses and it can be performed in relatively complex situations, as in triplet Markov models. The aim of this Note is to express a general theorem of convergence of ICE, and to show its applicability in the problem of the estimation of the proportions in a mixture of multivariate distributions. To cite this article: W. Pieczynski, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris, Ser. I 346 (2008).

documents.abstract: The liquidity risk is dened as an additional risk in the market dueto the timing and size of a trade. A recent work by Cetinet al. (2003)proposes a rigorous mathematical model incorporating this liquidity risk intothe arbitrage pricing theory. A practical problem arising in a real marketapplication is an estimation problem of a liquidity cost. In this paper, wepropose to estimate the liquidity cost function in the context of Cetinet al.(2003) using the constrained least square (LS) method, and illustrate it byanalyzing the Kellogg company data.

documents.abstract: This paper presents the ways that can improve the Software Cost Estimation Guidelines in order to replace those that are expected to be abolished at February, 2012, and solve the problems that are being occurred in the current Software Cost Estimation Guidelines. By using multidimensional modeling of OLAP(On-Line Analytical Processing), this paper does three dimensional modeling that considers the product/service view, process view and skill view. Also, it presents the identification method of cost estimation data through the view of each dimension. Furthermore, it defines the software cost estimation process and adapts them into the bottom up estimation and the top down estimation. Finally, it proposes the access of cost estimation data by the multidimensional analysis of OLAP.

documents.title: 전라 좌수영의 배치특성에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: Abstract A S셔요 on The Properties of the Plan which was plotted in CHOLLAJWASUYOUNG Oh, Jung-Hun Department of Architecture Engineering The Graduate School Sunchon National University Advisor : Prof. Nam, Ho Hyeon The beginning of Chosun dynasty featured a period to rearrange the regime of new dynasty alon with enhancing its systems. Those days, major enemies against our national defense were northern Manchurian and southern japanese pirates. In particular, Japanese pirates appeared frequently across the southern boundary under a somewhat unstable national circumstances just after the foundation of Chosun dynasty. Fundamentally, their existence led to the organization of Chosun nabal army and its development. Chosun naval army which was installed for national guard and defense against those Japanese pirates went through an inital evolution and gained a series of great successful results in the level of organization and formation during the period of King Sejong. It may be attributed to the results from a chain of efforts made by Chosun's court that aimed at building up a formulated foreign defense system. During Chosun dynasty, the lefthand defense camp in Jeolla province(hereinafter called 'Jeolla lefthand defense camp') was the headquarter of Jeolla lefthand naval army. In particular, it was a great strategic point led by our great admiral Yi, Sun-shin, which was critical enough to change a national fate in the front line against Japanese pirates during the Japanese invasion of chosun dynasty in the end of 16th century. Afterwards, Jeolla lefthand defense camp played its full roles as a strategic base crucial to the national defense against Japanese invasions over about 500 years till the 32nd year of King Kojong(1895), in which Chosun army was rdformed and reorganized on a full scale. As described above, Jeolla lefthand defense camp implies many essential clues for studying on naval camps in Chosun dynasty. Nevertheless, buildings in those days and related historical materials have been actually insufficient so far. Moreover, there has been no study on architectural level of local naval camp and fortress in Chosun dynasty. Instead, there have been excavation and survey of relics around fortress in the field of humanity and archaeology along with humanistic surveys based on literatures around local towns. First of all, this study aimed at indentifying general arrangement features of Chosun naval army camp and fortress by determining any correlations around some old towns or fortresses and naval army camp/fortress in Jeolla province addording to the name and location of each building. Then, the study considered respective building arrangement features within Jeolla naval army camp and fortress to identify its relationship with the arrangement of buildings as remained in the former Jeolla lefthand defense camp. In terms of arrangement of each building within Jeolla lefthand defense camp, the study focused on identifying functional features as shown in the location and arrangement of each building to clarify any characteristics in the arrangement of Jeolla lefthand defense camp in Chosun dynasty. In view of the absence of architectural studies which addressed our old military camp and fortress as a coastal defense base, this study on the arrangement features of Jeolla lefthand defense camp as one of naval army installations in Chosun dynasty may be significant, because of its availability as a basic material for follow-up studies which will also address the installations of old local naval army in the level of revival. Related lierature surve was based on the following sources: Descriptions related to our old naval army around Sejong Silok Jiriji(the Geography in Annals of King Sejong), Gyeongguk Daejeon(National Code for Dynastic Administration), JeungvoMungeonBigo (Supplementary Literatures and References); Suncheon Eupji and HoJoasuyeongji(a sort of local military map); Bibyeonsa Jido(a military map as made for the national defense of Chosun dynasty in the 18th century); Close examination and arrangement of building within camps and fortresses as shown in HoJoasijuyeongdo; and descriptions related to installations as shown in literatures which reveal the records about Jeolla naval army camps in Chosun dynasty. Based on archive and visual materials, this study analyzed how much differently central regions and their hierarchical characteristics appeared in terms of the arrangement of naval army camps around town fortress. To recognize the historical position and importance of our old naval army camp and fortress and identify their changes, Chapter 2 addressed the evolution and organizational trends of our old naval army camp or fortress and Jeolla lefthand defense camp according to the military system and administrative districts in Chosun dynasty. Chapter 3 compared old town or fortress and naval camp/fortress on the basis of the arrangement features of town or fortress along with the evolution of fortresses and other defense installations in the begining of Chosun dynasty according to the point of arrangement, and then considered the arrangement features of each building as shown around old nava camp and fortress. Chapter 4 intended to describe the arrangement features of Jeolla lefthand defense camp, and identified any correlation in building arrangement between Jeolla lefthand defense camp and other naval camps or fortresses, on the ground of arrangement features as deduced from analysis on the latter. Ultimately, this chapter made efforts to identify any ingerent characteristics of building arrangement in Jeolla lefthand defense camp. Accordingly, the results of comparative analysis on the features of installation arrangement between Jeonnam naval camps/fortresses and Jeolla lefthand defense camp can be summarized as follows: 1. Every fortress around naval camps was characterized by irregular forms along mountains and adjacent topography or coastline, which may imply an effective way to arrange defense camps and related installations around limited locations so that every camp could be located in some military strategic positions along coastline in terms of locational characteristics of our old naval camp. 2. Intramural gates within a naval camp and fortress were composed with regard to inherent arrangement norms of each town and its locational features. 3. It can be assumed that our medieval direction concepts for designing building arrangement might accept geomantical arrangement concepts and defensive direction toward coastal boundary zone in the military level. 4. Every accessory installation within naval camp and fortress had its core one located on its central upper position for the sake of hierarchical center. On its central lower position, administrative and military installations were located in their own special spaces respectively, other than those around inland towns. 5. It can be assumed that HoJoasuyeongdo was one of our medieval military maps, which was almost realistically drawn by the most advanced mapping technique in those days, so called 'multi-center 3-dimension conductive mapping,' which illustrated a ground plan of building within Jeolla lefthand defense camp. 6. After a series of military installations were built up around Jeolla lefthand defense camp, some critical installations moved into the center of camp, which evolved into a core axis of local administrative regions. Afterwards, it is estimated that Jeolla lefthand defense camp was finally finished with additional installations for low-class personnel by organizational system in the mid of 18th century. 7. During Japanese invasions of Chosun in the end of 16th century, Jinhaeru(a sort of fortress tower) was an installation for coordinating militarycommands and other businesses on the whole. Jinnam-gwan was locted in jinhaeru, because the location of Jingaeru provided a good military outlook and met basic requirements for a series of hierarchical formations around military core axis. 8. The arrangement of building within Jeolla lefthand defense camp seems to have an organic combination of its accessory installations. In particular, its supply installations were located in the center of camp to facilitate the supply of military munitions, which is considered a particular and unique arrangement as shown in the lefthand defense camp of naval.

documents.title: 방산수출 영향요인에 관한 연구 : 물류성과지수를 중심으로
documents.abstract: 세계은행의 물류성과지수가 방산수출에 미치는 영향을 알아보기 위해 2007년∼2019년까지 패널자료를 구축하였다. 특히 방산수출액을 기준으로 국가 소득수준별로 분석 대상을 구분하여 비교 분석하였으며, 설명변수로 물류성과지수 이외에 GDP, 국가 간 거리, 공적개발원조, 상호국방조달협정 등을 고려하였다.&#xD; 분석 결과, 본 연구에서 주목한 물류성과지수는 방산 수출에 정(+)의 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. 물류성과지수를 세부평가항목으로 나누어 분석한 결과 수출에 무역 및 운송 관련 인프라의 품질 및 물류 서비스의 품질과 역량 지수는 정(+)의 영향을 미쳤고, 통관의 효율성은 부(-)의 영향을 보였다. 위탁품을 추적할 수 있는 역량은 방산수출에는 유의미한 영향을 미치지 못하였으나, 방산수입에는 유의한 정(+)의 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다.&#xD; 본 연구의 성과 및 학문적 기여는 다음과 같다.&#xD; 첫째, 연구설계를 통해 방산수출에 영향을 미치는 요인에 대한 연구분석 절차와 방법을 정립하였다.&#xD; 둘째, 방위산업의 경제적 요인뿐만 아니라, 안보적 관계 등이 방산수출에 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 것을 실증분석하였다.&#xD; 셋째, 중력모형을 활용하여 방산 수출과 관련된 경제적 요인 및 물류성과지수등이 방산수출과의 인과관계를 분석할 수 있는 연구모형을 식별하였다.&#xD; 넷째, 실제 방산무역 데이터를 활용하여 기존 문헌의 AHP 등 정성적인 설문조사 방법에서 나아가 실증분석 하였다.&#xD; 다섯째, 신규 방산시장 탐색단계에서 활용 가능한 변수 추가로 수출 유망국가 선정에 기여하였다.Abstract&#xD; A Study on the Impact of Logistics Performance Index by Country on Defense Exports&#xD; Kim, Min Ho&#xD; Department of Defense Science&#xD; Korea National Defense University&#xD; This study set panel data from 2007 to 2019 to investigate the impact of the Wolrd Bank’s LPI(Logistics Performance Index) on Defense Export. &#xD; Particularly, this study compared and analyzed this impact by classified by national income level based on the amounts of Defense Export. It further considered GDP, ODA, RDP-MOU, Major Non NATO ally, Military expenditure and distance between countries, in addition to LPI indicators as explanatory variables. The results of the analysis showed that the LPI indicator has a positive effect on the total amounts of Defense Export. As a result of subdividing the LPI into six.&#xD; The analysis showed that “the logistics infrastructure index” , “Service quality index” have a positive effect on Defense exports, “Efficiency of customs index” has a negative effect on Defense exports. 'Ability to track and trace consignments intex' don't have a effect on defense exports, but it has a positive effect on defense&#xD; In this study, Analysis target were divided into four categories : “total countries”, 'low and lower-middle countries', 'upper-middle countries', and 'high-income countries'. Under these conditions, this study showed that there is a difference in the effects of the LPI. &#xD; The achievements and academic contributions of this study are as follows.&#xD; First, through research design, research analysis procedures and methods for factors affecting defense exports were established. Second, through empirical analysis, it was empirically verified that not only economic factors of the defense industry but also security relations can affect defense exports. Third, using the gravity model, a research model was presented that could effectively analyze the causal relationship between the economic factors related to defense exports and the logistics performance index. &#xD; Fourth, using actual defense trade data, empirical analysis was conducted by breaking away from qualitative survey methods such as AHP in the existing literature.&#xD; Fifth, the addition of variables that can be used in the new defense market search stage contributed to the selection of promising export countries.&#xD; &#xD; 주요어 : Defense Exports, LPI(Logistics Performance Index), Gravity model

documents.title: 국방 분야 빅데이터 성숙도 모형 개발에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: Over the past decade, defense intelligence organizations have evolved rapidly to perform new missions. They have developed new capabilities and adapted their business processes, especially in support of joint and complex military operations. But in the coming decade, their greatest challenge will be to develop new capabilities to manage and exploit big data. We use the term big data to mean the exponentially increasing amount of digital information being created by new information technologies—such as mobile Internet, cloud storage, social networking, and the “Internet of things”—and the advanced analytics used to process that data. Big data yields not simply a quantitative increase in information, but a qualitative change in how we create new knowledge and understand the world. These data-related information technologies have already begun to revolutionize commerce and science, transforming the economy and acting as enablers for other game-changing technology trends. In defense intelligence communities, some of these technologies have been adopted for tasks, including technical collection and operational intelligence fusion—but big data의 impact on all-source intelligence analysis has scarcely been examined.&#xD; Defense Big Data Maturity Models(DBDMM) are the artefacts used to measure defense big data maturity. These models help organizations to create structure around their big data capabilities and to identify where to start. They provide tools that assist organizations to define goals around their big data program and to communicate their big data vision to the entire organization. DBDMMs also provide a methodology to measure and monitor the state of a defense big data capability, the effort required to complete their current stage or phase of maturity and to progress to the next stage. Additionally, DBDMMs measure and manage the speed of both the progress and adoption of big data programs in the organization.&#xD; &#xD; The goals of DBDMMs are:&#xD; 1) To provide a capability assessment tool that generates specific focus on big data in key defense areas&#xD; 2) To help guide development milestones&#xD; 3) To avoid pitfalls in establishing and building big data capabilities&#xD; &#xD; Six assessment areas of DBDMMs refer to ① big data policy, ② big data organization, ③ big data use and process, ④ big data technology, ⑤ big data security, and ⑥ big data people. And the subcomponents include alignment, architecture, data, data governance, delivery, development, measurement, program governance, scope, skills, statistical modelling, technology, value and visualization etc.&#xD; &#xD; The five stages of maturity of the proposed model are proposed as follows: &#xD; 1) Awareness - the starting stage for use of a new or undocumented repeating process. The awarenes stage as a pre–big data environment. During this stage the organization has a low awareness of big data or its value; There is little to no executive support for the effort and only some people in the organization are interested in potential value of big data; The Organization understand the benefits of analytics and may have a data warehouse. An organization의 governance strategy is typically more IT-centric rather than being integrative business-and-IT centric.&#xD; 2) Start-up - the process is at least big data sufficiently. During the pre-adoption stage: The organization start to investigate big data analytics.&#xD; 3) Investment - the financing is defined/confirmed as a standard business process&#xD; 4) Strategic utilization - the process is quantitatively managed in accordance with defense metric view point.&#xD; 5) Optimization - process management includes deliberate process optimization/improvement.&#xD; &#xD; The study helps defense related organizations in Korea determine 1) where it currently lands on the big data maturity spectrum, and 2) take steps to get to the next level.빅데이터 시대를 맞이하여 국방부문에서도 앞 다투어 빅데이터 정책 및 사업을 추진하고 있다. 그러나 내부를 파악해보면 데이터 수집과 분석 능력을 보유한 일부 IT기업이나 금융회사 등 대기업 중심으로 추진되고 있고 국방 분야의 경우에는 단발성 프로젝트 위주로 빅데이터 사업을 제한적으로 시행하거나 기존에 수행해오던 정보화 관련 사업을 빅데이터 사업으로 사업 명칭만 바꾼 사례도 있다. &#xD; 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방과 연관된 분야에서 빅데이터 정책을 계획수립 또는 수립하고 있거나 현재 도입중인 군관련 기관 및 방산업체들이 이러한 문제에 직면하게 되었을 때 필요한 일종의 지침을 제공하기 위한 목적으로 개발하였다. 즉, 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방 빅데이터 정책 전반에 대한 이해를 제고하고, 조직구성원들과 협력 및 의사소통을 구할 수 있으며, 빅데이터와 관련하여 무엇을 어디에서부터 개시해야 하는지에 대한 확실한 가이드라인을 제공한다. 그리고 지금 무엇을 하고 있으며 어떤 것을 못하고 있는지, 빅데이터 수준이 어디까지 와있고 어느 정도의 수준에까지 도달했는지 기준을 제공한다. 또한 향후 빅데이터 정책이나 추진의 방향성이 어떠한지도 제시해 주며, 또한 국방 분야의 빅데이터 수준을 진단하거나 상호 비교 및 평가하여 국방 분야 빅데이터 정책 수립에 활용될 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 평가영역과 발전단계의 수로 구성된다. 본 논문에서는 평가영역을 설정하기 위하여 전문가를 대상으로 한 합의 델파이 방법(Consensus Delphi method)을 적용하여 ① 빅데이터 정책, ② 빅데이터 조직, ③ 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스, ④ 빅데이터 기술, ⑤ 빅데이터 보안, ⑥ 빅데이터 인력의 6개 영역을 선정하였다. 빅데이터 정책에는 빅데이터 계획과 빅데이터 전략, 빅데이터 정책 결정 등을 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 조직에는 빅데이터 전담조직 및 추진 체계, 빅데이터 거버넌스 구축 및 빅데이터 표준화와 품질관리 조직 등을 평가 대상으로 하고 있으며, 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스에는 데이터의 출처 및 용도, 빅데이터 생성과정, 빅데이터 구조를 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 기술에는 빅데이터의 수집, 저장 및 분석 역량과 최적화 기술역량을 등을 평가 한다. 빅데이터 보안에는 보안 등급 및 관련 규정 및 공공데이터의 성격을 가지는 경우 개방성에 대한 판단도 주요한 평가 대상으로 포함하고 있으며, 마지막으로 빅데이터 인력에서는 IT전문가 집단의 역량, 데이터 과학자의 역량 및 리더십과 운영인력 등을 평가할 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 6개의 평가영역과 더불어 성숙도 단계를 인지단계, 착수단계, 예산투입단계, 활용단계, 최적화 단계의 다섯 단계로 구성하였다. 인지단계는 전체적으로 빅데이터에 대한 인식 정도가 낮고 사용 가능한 수준의 빅데이터가 거의 없고 제한된 영역 내에서만 빅데이터 분석이 적용되는 단계를 의미한다. 착수단계는 국방 빅데이터에 대한 종사자의 인식 변화가 태동하며 국방 빅데이터 기술 및 지식을 습득하고 군 고유의 데이터 플랫폼과 인프라 스트럭처를 구성하지만, 도구(tool)과 기술이 제한적인 수준임을 의미한다. 예산투입 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석 활동의 시작을 의미하는데, 효율적인 빅데이터 사용이 가능하고, 여러 가지 종류의 국방 빅데이터 기술과 빅데이터 조직과 거버넌스 체계가 존재하며 외부 사용자나 방산업체 등에서 생성된 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높은 수준을 의미한다. 활용단계는 빅데이터 분석 기술이 중요해지며 분석 및 해석이 중요해지는 단계로 예측과 시각화 응용 프로그램의 사용이 가능하며 IT 시스템 아키텍처가 군 내부자원의 보안을 보장하는 단계이다. 끝으로 최적화 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석이 경제적 부가 가치를 창출하는 단계와 연관되며, 군 빅데이터가 강력한 빅데이터 거버넌스 하에 국방 관련 조직 전체로 공유되는 단계이며, 이 단계는 데이터 아트(art) 수준의 작업이 수행되는 단계를 말한다. &#xD; 본 연구에서 개발한 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 시범 모형의 일종으로서 앞으로 국방 분야의 다양한 과업에서 실질적인 적용을 통하여 수정되고 보완되어 지속적으로 발전되어야 할 것이다.

documents.title: 《甲骨文合集》에 보이는 征伐動詞 硏究
documents.abstract: Shang Dynasty is an ancient empire developed by keeping up militarily rivalry with many other countries. This is the reason that we can find out many of details related to the warfare and combats between the Shang and other neighboring countries in the ‘bone scripts’ that is the important record showing the Shang’s society and features. People of later ages classified them into the warfare record and the oracle bones scripts with them are categorized as ‘the warfare oracle bones inscription.’ Especially, ‘the warfare verb’ on the oracle bones inscription is very important in order for us to understand the circumstance of their expedition.&#xD; Twenty two warfare verbs in total can be found in a great collection of bone scripts, 《Jia gu wen He ji》 by ‘Guo Mo Ruo’(郭沫若). This can be divided into attacking, defending, guarding position, marching, staying and obtaining war prisoners and casualties by warfare.&#xD; Among the letters related to attack, 'Zheng(正)', 'Zheng(征)', 'Fa(伐)', 'Cha'and 'Chun' were used as the meaning of ‘attack’, 'Qi(啓)' and 'Zhao(肇)' implied the attack at the head. The letter 'Gou(구)' as encountering the enemy.&#xD; The letters related to the defense are 'Yu(御)', 'Wei(衛)'and 'Shu(戍)', and these were basically used as the meaning of 'defend' and sometimes used as a defensive war. In case of 'Zhen(진)', it was the letter of guarding position,&#xD; 'Bu(步)'and 'She(涉)' were the descriptive letters of the plan for marching and crossing water, 'Li(立)' and 'Ci' implied the staying of army. The letter 'Di','Tu(途)'and 'Zai(진)' as destroying or killing the enemy. 'Sang(桑)' and 'Chi(稚)' were used as verbs to describe the occurrence of casualties due to the warfare. 'Nie'and 'Zhi(執)' implied obtaining the war prisoners.&#xD; In the oracle bone scripts using these verbs, the countries or individuals for the target of the war campaign were used as objective and their position in the sentence is preposition or postposition for the verb. In the case of using more than two warfare verbs in one oracle script, the difference of usage could be classified as parallel relation and casual relation.

documents.title: 軍需調達 行政의 效果的 運營方案에 관한 硏究
documents.abstract: Nations all over are striving towards a more efficient and productive administration through dynamic application of Information/Communication Technology to administrative work. We are facing North Korea in the state of armistice for more than 50 years. Military threats and Nuclear Weapon problems and the withdrawal of the US forces are all factors highlighting more than ever the importance of self-reliant national defense. Thus, an increased amount of equipment, materiel and labor were required. Resulting in the larger Defense expenditures and Defense procurement expenditures. Logistics Procurement have come to execute 50% of the Defense Expenditures, and are influencing numerous areas significantly. In order to enable an efficient execution of the Defense Budget and procure logistics supplies of adequate quality, a study suggesting a detailed procurement procedure to enhance efficiency through improvement of the Defense Procurement Administration process and a one-stop system to accelerate the procurement process. jo dal won confirmation(domestic, foreign common goods), Procurement conditions, contract method(contract form, contract method, bidding conditions, delivery date and site), Generate Remarks(Inspection type, government issued facts and miscellaneous conditions), Contract Unit composition, Final Decision(Director, Department Manager) was studied about Procurement judgement process for Decision of a reasonable execution route for requested procurement commodity Acquiring Price Competitiveness through economy of scale and with speciality as a base, efforts to provide various services to satisfy customer needs through a low cost economic procurement and to establish a highly efficient National Defense must be made, and discovered the relative merits of a centralized procurement system and a decentralized one. Difference in history, the legal system and culture resulted in a different procurement system. Nations are on a trend of switching their decentralized system of procurement to a centralized one in order to maximize the benefits of concentrated purchase. Developed nations' strategic trend is to modify the procurement process and making it efficient is to construct an Electronic Procurement System and towards a concentrated(centralized) purchase. The computer based system allowed the “nara-jangtur(national on-line market) to switch into an electric procurement environment. I explained centralized procurement and decentralized procurement separately. A study of the major functions, handled commodity, contract type, price calculation, applied specifications, budget and payment of the Public Procurement Service and the Procurement Headquarters were made. A legal / systematic innovation and the adequate development of management and operation were discovered to apply it to a more efficient logistics procurement. Recently, Defense acquisition system reform committee has suggested the foundation of the Defense Industry Service. The administrative workload assigned to eight organizations under MND control will be combined into the Defense Industry Service. There are worried voices questioning that such 통합 will loosen outer inspection and increase possibility of corruption, but the government has passed laws related to the foundation of the Defense Industry Service, and have started a promotion team to complete the organizational structure and will be founded on the 1st of January 2006. If it is executed as planned, it will evidently become a trigger of a developing logistics procurement administration that is trusted by the people and result in the of the usefulness of this study. Expecting and hoping the foundation of the Defense Industry Service on schedule Procurement.오늘의 세계 각국은 情報通信技術을 行政에 접목시킴으로써 일하는 방식을 근본적으로 개편하여 行政의 效率性과 業務 生産性을 提高 하고, 對國民 서비스를 획기적으로 改善하기 위해 다각적인 努力을 경주 하고 있다. 우리는 북한과 휴전상태로 50년 이상을 대치하고 있다. 軍事的 威脅과 核問題, 駐韓美軍 撤收 등 國內的으로 自主國防의 必要性이 어느 때보다 강조되고 있는 실정이다. 이에 따라 自主國防을 위하여 많은 裝備와 物資·用役을 必要하기에 이르렀다. 그러기에 國防費와 國防調達額의 規模도 커지게 되었다. 國防費의 50% 이상을 집행하는 軍需調達은 여러 분야에 걸쳐서 影響을 끼치고 있다. 이 연구는 막대한 國防豫算을 效率的으로 執行하고, 각 軍에서 必要한 良質의 軍需 物資를 적기에 調達하기 위하여 調達業務에 관한 細部施行節次를 제시함으로써, 能率的인 業務遂行을 위한 國防調達行政의 業務 프로세스 즉, 購買決定 過程에서 代金支拂까지 모든 調達過程을 원스톱으로 처리하도록 구축된 電子調達에 관해 살펴본 것이다. 調達指示(요구) 品目의 合理的인 집행 方案을 決定하기 위한 調達判斷節次에 관해 조달원 확인(內資, 外資調達, 常用物資), 調達要件確認(豫算, 目錄, 規格), 契約方法決定(契約形態, 契約方法, 入札資格, 納期 , 납지), 특수조건설정(檢査形態, 관급사항, 기타 조건), 契約單位 構成, 最終決定 (본부장, 사업부장) 일련의 과정을 두루 살펴보았다. 規模의 經濟를 통한 價格 競爭力의 우위 확보와 專門性을 바탕으로 顧客滿足을 위한 다양한 서비스를 提供함으로써 저비용 經濟調達을 통해 고효율의 튼튼한 國防力을 創出하기 위한 努力에 모두 힘을 모아야겠다는 생각을 더욱 갖게 되었으며, 中央調達과 分散調達制度는 각각의 장·단점을 갖고 있다. 역사와 문화 법률체계의 相異함으로 인해 각각의 특성에 맞는 形態로 政府調達을 運營하고 있으며, 分散 調達制度를 채택하고 있는 나라에서도 최근 集中購買의 利點을 살리기 위해 中央調達制度로 전환하는 추세에 있다. 이러한 調達의 效率化를 위하여 선진 주요국의 전략적 추세는 統合電子調達 체계의 구축과 集中購買 方式으로 채택하는 방향으로 나가고 있다. 특히 統合電子 조달시스템으로 구축된 나라 장터는 中央調達과 分散調達의 단점을 제거하는 상생의 電子調達環境으로 전환하는 추세이다. 본연구는 軍需調達行政의 方法으로 시행중인 中央調達과 部隊調達을 區分하였으며, 常用物資 調達廳에 移管 購買하는 軍需調達의 主業務를 시행하는 調達本部의 주요 기능에 대해서 取扱品目, 購買形態, 契約形態, 價格算定, 適用規格, 豫算, 代金支拂을 區分하여 살펴보았다. 또한 效率的인 軍需調達의 改善方向에 관해 法的/制度的 改善과 管理運營의 合理的 발전 방법도 찾아보았다. 최근에 國防部에서는 國防獲得制度 改善團의 發足으로 防衛事業廳 신설이 진행되고 있다. 國防部 산하 8개 기관에서 담당하던 武器獲得과 防産業務를 防衛事業廳으로 단일화하는 方案으로 改善하려고 애쓰고 있는 실이다. 하지만 정치권에서는 外部統制機能을 느슨하게 조성해 비리의 발생 소지를 키울 수 있다면서 사업의 전면 再檢討를 주장하고 있지만 政府에서는 ‘05년 6월까지 방위사업청 新設과 關聯된 政府組織法과 防衛事業法을 제정한 뒤 開廳準備團을 발족해 올 연말까지 조직정비를 완료하고 ’06 1월 1일 開廳 豫定을 전제하고, 지난 6월 30일 국회에서 정부조직법이 통과돼 한숨 돌렸다. 이것이 계획된 대로 이루어진다면, 부패방지 기능도 발휘하고 國民에게 신뢰받는 軍需調達行政도 가능할 것이다. 더구나 이는 이 논문이 추구하는 國防現代化에 기여할 군수조달 행정의 획기적 발전을 끌어낼 주요한 계기가 될 것으로 기대된다.

documents.title: 능동적인 보안 관제를 위한 체계적 보안 플랫폼에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: 기존의 보안관제(Security Control and Management)가 지니고 있는 한계점 등은 지능화하는 융합형 공격(Multi-Vector)등에 취약하다. 본 논문에서는 능동적인 보안관제를 위한 체계적인 보안 플랫폼에 관한 연구를 제안한다. 기존 허니팟의 체계 및 대응 방법은 일반적으로 취약한 서비스를 구현(emulation)하여 공격 탐지를 하는 낮은 상호작용 방식(Low Interaction Honeypot)이거나, 가상 시스템(Virtual System)을 활용한 방식(High Interactive Honeypot)으로 나뉜다. 후자의 경우, 제로데이 공격 등을 탐지할 수 있는 효과적인 방법이 될 수 있으나, 샘플 수집에 대한 제약 및 허니넷 (Honeynet) 영역의 제한에 대한 적극적인 대응방식이 필요하다. 따라서, 이를 능동형 보안관제 플랫폼에 적용하여, 실제 대형 인터넷 서비스망에 6가지 수집 채널을 구현하고, 가상머신에서 설치된 행위기반 탐지 클라이언트를 통해 봇넷 탐지를 한 결과, 대용량 공격 이전에 봇넷의 공격명령서버(C&amp;C) 및 악성봇 유포지 등을 사전에 탐지해내는 결과를 도출 해 냈다. 이를 실제 봇넷 은닉형 악성코드 사례에 적용해 낸 결과, 타 인터넷서비스망에 비해 현저하게 낮은 악성코드 감염률 등의 효과를 확인할 수 있었다. 또한, 시스템 보안 관제 영역에서는 기존에 알려진 취약점 데이터 베이스(OSVDB, CVSS)를 활용한 침입경로 탐지 시스템을 제안하여, 다양한 취약점 공격 시도들을 사전에 차단 할 수 있도록 하였다. 기존의 취약점 측정 방식(Vulnerability Scoring Metrics)이 시스템 관리자 입장에서 제안 되었던 방법에서 벗어나, 보다 효율적인 침입루트 계산을 위해 공격자 위치에서 최적화된 공격 루트를 제공하는 HRMS(Hacking Response Measurement System Scoring Metrics)를 제안하고, 시스템간 인증 방식 분류를 통한 인증 취약점 측정 방식을 구현하여 보다 실질적인 공격 루트 탐지 결과를 얻을 수 있었다. 또한, 네트워크 플로우(NetFlow)를 활용한 대용량 공격탐지시스템인 NTAS(NetFlow Traffic Analsys System)은 네트워크 관제영역에서 사용 되는 필수의 모니터링 기법으로, DDoS 트래픽의 효율적인 차단에 능동적으로 대응 하므로서, 대용량 공격으로부터 고객서비스 뿐아니라 네트워크 기반시설을 효과적으로 보호하게 되었다. 따라서, 보안관제의 두 가지 가장 큰 영역인 사이버 네트워크 보안영역과 시스템 보안영역에 능동형 허니팟 시스템 및 넷플로기반 모니터링 시스템(NTAS)과 해킹방어대응 시스템(HRMS) 및 새로운 패러다임의 DDoS 대응 프레임워크(Framework)를 구현 제안 하므로 해서, 나날이 지능화되고 타깃화되는 사이버 공격에 적극 대처할 수 있는 체계적인 보안 플랫폼을 제안한다.

documents.title: 군사시설 이전.확보대책 및 주변지역 지원방안에 관한 연구
documents.abstract: 영문초록:A Study on military installation relocation and procurement measures and surrounding area support planHa, Gum-ryulMajor in Real Estate ManagementThe Graduate School of Real EstateKonkuk UniversityThe military should be provided with the budget, manpower. land and the like necessary for protecting national existence and prosperity from a perspective of public goods as it is the agent in charge of national defense. But the reality is that military establishments are becoming the object of repugnance for local government in which military establishments are located is subjected to constraints in executing the district development and exercising the property right. Accordingly, this study attempted to present the scheme to secure the required budget and land as the scheme to resolve this problem. First of all, it attempted to present the scheme to secure the government-level support when the amount of sale is insufficient to appropriate for the project cost along with the scheme to maximize the revenues from the sale of the land required for the military establishments to move. And it sought to present the need to complement the military establishment removal system based on the self-supporting accounting system. And this study attempted to present the alternative after examining the scope, contents and object of support at the dimension of compensation by considering that local inhabitants and local government are subjected to constraints in making use of land and space in accordance with the stationing of the military establishments. It attempted to offer an understanding of the basis for the scheme to support the district to which the military establishment will be moved in the future by making a concrete examination of the cases of the support policy for surrounding districts to which the US military base will be moved to Pyongtaek through the enactment of the Special Law on Support for Pyongtaek by government. Finally, it sought to present the role of local community as the scheme to raise the role of the military in local community and the realistic support schemes such as the scheme to readjust the military damage compensation and indemnity system and the scheme to revitalize the local consultation body. In conclusion, this study examined the budget required to remove and expand the military establishments. And it analyzed and examined the scheme to provide support for the surrounding district in which military establishments are located as the measure to reduce and prevent the problem directly related to maintaining the current location of military establishments and securing the new land required for them, the tendency of local community to avoid military establishments

documents.title: 艮齋 李德弘의 註釋書 撰述과 壬亂 克服意識
documents.abstract: The family origin of Kanjae(艮齋, penname) Yi Duk-Hong(李德弘, 1541～1596) was Youngcheon(永川), his pseudonym(字) was Gyeng-Jung(宏仲) and he was a metaphysicist who lived in the middle of Chosun(朝鮮) Dynasty. This study focused on the writing of the commentary by Yi Duk-Hong as a scholar and his consciousness of overcoming Japanese invasion(壬亂) in order to understand what Yi Duk-Hong was. Yi Duk-Hong devoted sincerely to learning for 12 years from his becoming a disciple of Yi Hwang(李滉) until he died. He never failed to ask questions about any suspicious matter and to write what he could understand from the questions. So he left the most commentaries among disciples. The “Four Books Inquiries(四書質疑)” of Yi Duk-Hong was used as material in the publication of “Four Books Commentary(四書釋義)” of Yi Hwang when the handwriting of it was lost at the time of Japanese Invasion, and the “Book of Changes Inquiries(周易質疑)” contains much of his creative materials that can be used to measure the depth of his fortune-telling lore(易學). “Ancient Literature Inquiries(古文質疑)” is useful to understand the commentary situation of “Ancient Literature Treasure(古文眞寶)” of Toegye(退溪) School at that time, and “Family Customary Formalities(家禮註解)” is the first family customary formalities commentary written by Toegye School becoming the basis of the family customary formalities commentaries following it. Especially “Discussion of Ju-Ja(朱子) letter's digest(朱書節要講錄)” and “Mental Inquiries(心經質疑)” of his commentaries have had much effect on future generations. The former was so great influenced that following Ju-Ja's scholars at that time copied to use as their essential reference book in understanding the letters of Ju-Ja. The latter gave much influence to the Confucianism in the latter period of the Chosun Dynasty as a lecture in the royal court at the time of King Hyo-Jong(孝宗) used this book as a reference. Afterward Song Si-Yeol (宋時烈) and others wrote “Mental Question Commentary(心經附註釋義)” by complemented the book by the decree of King Sook-Jong(肅宗). The consciousness of Yi Duk-Hong about overcoming Japanese invasion is well shown in his two appeal letters to King Sunjo(宣祖) and Kwanghae the crown prince(光海君). We can know his outstanding knowledge of military strategy and his loyalty to the kingdom. Specific and practical measures were recommended in his appeal letters such as shooters' utilization of mountaineers(山尺), utilization of new battle formation(陣法), utilization of castles as effective defense method, establishment of wooden barricades(木柵) and utilization of tortoise shell boats(龜甲船). Especially it is surprising that he made “Drawing of Tortoise Shell Boat(龜甲船圖)” which is assumed to be the original drawing of the “Turtle Ship(거북선, 龜船)”. It is sorry we are lacking in the material to prove the correlation between his “Drawing of Tortoise Shell Boat” and the “Turtle Ship” of General Yi Sun-Shin (李舜臣), but the fact itself that he created the idea of “Tortoise Shell Boat(龜甲船)” has considerable meaning. His philosophical achievement as a neo-confucianist enables us to measure his position in the history of ideas and “Toegye School(退溪學派)”. Especially his position related to “Toegye Studies(退溪學)” should be reviewed more closely in future. This study tried to grasp what he really was in light of his life as an outstanding scholar and excellent official, but failed to find it owing to shortage of related materials and my ability, remaining a subject to be studied in future.
